outputs.Bid Submission Type: Electronic via iSupplier portal or manual sealed paper submission (mail/FedEx/UPS). No fax or email submissions.
outputs.Term of Bid: 3-year initial term with two (2) successive one (1) year renewal options, not to exceed a total of 5 years.
outputs.Pre Bid Meeting: June 10, 2024, 2:00 PM CST (3:00 PM EDT) via TEAMS video conference. Attendance is not mandatory.
outputs.Delivery Date: Dallas ISD is anticipating requesting quotes for different projects from awarded vendors starting in September of 2024.
outputs.Installation: Yes. Deployment services are required, including software installation, asset tagging and etching, device deployment and setup, and asset control reporting. Imaging on devices is also required.

outputs.Bid Bond Requirement: Required, submission of a certificate of insurance/bond is necessary. Specific amount or percentage not specified in provided documents.
outputs.Payment Terms: Prime vendors must pay all submitted invoices, including retainage, to subcontractors, suppliers, or entities within 10 days of receiving payment from the district. No Prime vendor shall withhold a non-disputed subcontractor payment. No Prime vendor may withhold retainage greater than 5% from the subcontractor. The contract between prime vendor and subcontractor should include payment terms, prompt payment clause, and retainage clause.
outputs.Any Additional Documentation Required: Certificate of insurance/bond, MWBE Forms (must be completed regardless of MWBE status), W9 Form (completed, signed, and attached). For proposing vendors who are resellers, a copy of all factory-authorized repair and maintenance certifications must be submitted with each proposal. A Letter of Intent (LOI) for M/WBE Subcontractors is required at the contract negotiation meeting or as requested by the M/WBE Department, not with the initial bid/proposal.
outputs.MFG for Registration: Bidders who are resellers must be authorized by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and provide factory-authorized repair and maintenance certifications. All warranties must be official manufacturer warranties and made by OEM.
outputs.Contract or Cooperative to use: Central Texas Purchasing Alliance (CTPA) Interlocal Agreement - Cooperative, Educational Purchasing Cooperative of North Texas (EPCNT) Interlocal Agreement ('Rider').
outputs.contact_info: Procurement questions: Name: Sherri Williams, Email: shewilli@dallasisd.org. General Procurement Services: Phone: 972-925-3700, Email: ProcurementCS@dallasisd.org.

outputs.Bid Summary: The Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is soliciting proposals for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors can submit proposals for one, several, or all categories, with the District reserving the right to award contracts to single or multiple vendors. The RFP outlines minimum hardware requirements for each device tier, and vendors must be capable of providing significant quantities over the five-year contract period. The bid, identified as JA-207652, has a closing date of July 9, 2024, at 03:00 PM EDT.
